event: A splashing sound occurs when a bowl's contents spill on the dining table.

sounding_object.description: A small, light-colored (likely white or cream) ceramic bowl, round, approximately 10-15 cm in diameter. At the time of the sound, it contains small, colorful items (possibly fruit pieces or candy) which spill onto the wooden dining table.

reference_object.description: A stainless steel countertop oven/toaster oven, located on the kitchen counter.

facing_object.description: A large, rectangular wooden dining table located in the dining area.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the countertop oven and facing the wooden dining table, when the splashing sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
